reviewer: security-team (independent structured review over the verified security properties and the security pipeline)

findings.title: RSA timing side channel (Marvin Attack, RUSTSEC-2023-0071)
findings.disposition: Exempted with owner + future expiry (2026-11-15). Usage is client-side host-key validation / RSA key parsing with no network-observable private-key operations; the advisory workaround (local use) applies. Plan: reassess at expiry and upgrade when an upstream constant-time patch lands.
findings.retest: cargo-audit re-run confirms exactly the one exempted advisory; no unexempted high/critical.

findings.title: Single-use token replay window could grow unboundedly over a long soak
findings.disposition: Fixed in T142: consumed tokens are pruned (token_id -> expires_at) so the replay window stays bounded; soak test verifies peak <= 4096.
findings.retest: gateway-auth contract + gateway-soak contract pass; bounded-memory assertion green.

findings.title: SSRF: private/metadata/link-local targets reachable through the gateway
findings.disposition: Fixed in T136: default-deny private/link-local/loopback/metadata/reserved ranges, SSH-only port policy, host allowlist, DNS-rebinding guard.
findings.retest: gateway-address-policy contract passes the SSRF bypass test set.

findings.title: Risk of long-lived SSH keys being persisted by the gateway
findings.disposition: Fixed in T137: CredentialPolicy rejects long-lived key persistence; keys stay client-side end-to-end; short-lived in-memory session keys only.

findings.title: Cross-device isolation and field encryption need verification
findings.disposition: Verified in T093-T095: field-encrypted sync protocol, CRDT with device lifecycle isolation, e2e device lifecycle test.
findings.retest: sync-service e2e + crdt + sync-protocol + field-encryption contracts pass.

retest_confirmation.security_pipeline: pass (scripts/test-security-pipeline.mjs): static analysis, dependency audit, binary hardening, secret scan, supply-chain gate
